entities.summary: Thadeu Gomes Canellas was a Brazilian Roman Catholic bishop who served as the first bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Osório from its establishment in 1999 until his retirement in 2006. Prior to this he was auxiliary bishop of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Porto Alegre for sixteen years.
